description:
Welcome to the night shift! You just got a job running a small, 24-hour shawarma stand on a dark, quiet street. It seems like an easy way to earn some quick cash. Wait for a customer to approach the window, prepare their food, and collect the money. However, as the midnight crowd arrives, you'll quickly realize that this isn't an ordinary neighborhood and that not everyone on the other side of the glass is human.

To survive in this kiosk, you need to be paranoid and have a sharp eye. As each customer approaches to place an order, observe them closely and check the security cameras for anything unusual. Are their voices distorted? Are their facial features morphing into something monstrous? Is there an unsettling shadow lurking just out of sight? Learn to spot these terrifying anomalies hiding in plain sight.

When a guest checks out, treat them to a delicious shawarma and send them on their way. However, if your gut tells you something is wrong, do not hesitate. Hit the red emergency button and slam the heavy metal shutters down immediately. You cannot afford to be careless. You only have five chances to mess up. If you make too many mistakes by feeding a monster or turning away a normal person, you will summon the dreaded Inspector. If he arrives at your window, your shift is over... and your life might be, too. 

Do you have the nerve to survive until morning?
